returned_title: Federal Parliament Election 1972 (Panel: 2nd Wave, October 1971 - January 1972)
justification: This dataset is part of the NOS election study series (NOS-verkiezingsonderzoek, 1971-1972) archived by DANS and indexed in the CESSDA Data Catalogue under DOI 10.17026/DANS-2XT-AD3J.

returned_title: Sozialer Wandel und Gewaltkriminalität (Social Change and Violent Crime)
justification: This dataset, authored by Helmut Thome and Christoph Birkel and distributed by the GESIS Data Archive for the Social Sciences (Study No. ZA8194), examines long-term trends in social change and violent crime across Germany, England, and Sweden from 1950 to 2004.

returned_title: Sozialwissenschaftliche Telefonumfragen in der Allgemeinbevölkerung über das Mobilfunknetz (CELLA 1)
justification: This dataset, hosted by the GESIS Data Archive (ZA4875), contains the data from the CELLA 1 project on conducting social science telephone interviews among the general public via mobile phone and landline networks.

returned_title: Political Situation in West Berlin (Young People from the GDR)
justification: This dataset, archived in the GESIS Data Archive under Study No. ZA0590, contains survey data collected in January 1955 by the United States Information Agency (USIA) and DIVO regarding attitudes towards the economic and political situation in West Berlin from the perspective of young refugees from the GDR.
This dataset, archived by GESIS under study number ZA6621 and conducted on behalf of the German Federal Press Office, measures public trust in democracy, politics, parties, and media in Germany.

This dataset (Study ZA7315) contains survey data on television viewing behavior and audience responses in the German Democratic Republic (GDR) for week 5 of 1988, archived and distributed by the GESIS Data Archive.

returned_title: Second European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks 2014 (ESENER-2)
justification: This is the official DOI for the Second European Survey of Enterprises on New and Emerging Risks 2014 (ESENER-2) dataset cataloged and distributed via GESIS Data Archive.

This dataset, archived by the GESIS Data Archive under study number ZA0682, contains survey data commissioned by the Federal Centre for Health Education (BZgA) regarding attitudes toward family planning and contraception.

returned_title: Partnership Conflicts and Psychosomatic Gynecological Illnesses 1988/89 (Additional Survey: Sterile Women)
justification: This study/dataset (originally conducted in 1988/89 by J. Begenau and M. Rauchfuß at Humboldt University of Berlin / Charité under the German title 'Partnerschaftskonflikte und psychosomatische gynäkologische Erkrankungen') investigated partnership conflicts, sexuality, and psychosomatic symptoms among women in gynecological outpatient clinics in East Berlin, including an additional survey on sterile women.

returned_title: Sexual Conduct of Men and Women in the Federal Republic of Germany 1989
justification: This dataset (GESIS Study No. ZA2235) contains survey data collected in 1989 examining attitudes toward sexuality, AIDS, and sexual conduct among men and women in the Federal Republic of Germany.

returned_title: "Arma sunt necessaria" (Arms are necessary) Guns, Gun Culture and Cultural Origins of the Second Amendment to the U.S. Constitution
justification: This work by Michael Lenz examines 18th-century gun culture and the cultural origins of the Second Amendment to the U.S. Constitution, including the chapter titled "'Arma sunt necessaria': Guns and their Meaning in Eighteenth-Century Massachusetts and South Carolina" published by Böhlau Verlag.

The dataset 'A Survey of Europe Today (Finland)' (also indexed under 'A Survey of Europe Today (Finnland)'), part of the Reader's Digest cross-national consumer survey series, is available and indexed in the CESSDA Data Catalogue.

This dataset (GESIS Study ZA3222), conducted by IPOS and published via GESIS Data Archive, contains survey data on public perceptions, democracy judgments, and political expectations on the occasion of the 50th anniversary of the Federal Republic of Germany.

returned_title: Future Plans of Young People at Special Schools of Emotional and Social Development
justification: This dataset (GESIS Study No. ZA6262), authored by Jakob Heuschmidt, investigates the future life plans and transition choices of young people attending special schools for emotional and social development in Germany.
This dataset portal hosted by Open Data Duisburg contains data, results, and reports for the Duisburg Citizen Survey (Duisburger Bürgerbefragung).

returned_title: Flash Eurobarometer 10 (Managers - Knowledge about European Institutions for economic support)

returned_title: Labour market policy in the German Empire.

returned_title: The CFS's (Center for Financial Studies) historical money and capital market data base, Germany 1871 to 1914
justification: This dataset, produced by the Center for Financial Studies at the University of Frankfurt and authored by Steffen Eube, Anja Weigt, and Johannes Müller, covers historical money and capital market time series for Germany between 1871 and 1914, available via the GESIS Data Archive.

justification: This dataset (GESIS Study ZA6350) captures the survey data regarding the social situation and political orientations of citizens in Jena prior to the municipal election in May 1990.

returned_title: Vorbereitende Untersuchungen gemäß §141 BauGB und §165 Abs. 4 BauGB - [WMS]

justification: This dataset, produced as part of the German Business Panel (GBP) longitudinal study, contains survey data from German firm executives on the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic and is distributed by GESIS for on-site use.

justification: This historical dataset, compiled by Jürgen Sensch and published by the GESIS Data Archive (ZA8614) as part of the histat collection, contains historical index time series on wages and salaries in Germany from 1913/14 to 2006.

justification: This study (GESIS Study No. ZA6342), conducted by the Berliner Institut für Sozialwissenschaftliche Studien (BISS) in 1990, surveyed foreign citizens living in Eastern Germany regarding their living conditions, migration intentions, and perceptions of relations between Germans and foreigners.

justification: This dataset (GESIS study ZA0265 / Emnid, 1967) contains survey and readership analysis data for the Mannesmann company magazine UNSER WERKTAG, archived in the GESIS Data Archive.

justification: This dataset was created by Silvia Bolgherini, Mattia Casula, and Mariano Marotta (2018) to analyze forms of intermunicipal cooperation and municipal unions in Italy from 1996 to 2015, and is cataloged in the IRIS institutional research repository.

returned_title: Social Structure in the Lignite Area West of the Rhine (Relocated Villages)

returned_title: Social and Political Attitudes 2024 (Cumulated Data Set)

returned_title: Young People in Organized Leisure Time
justification: This dataset, cataloged by GESIS (Study No. ZA0527) and available via the CESSDA Data Catalogue, examines the significance of leisure clubhouses and organized leisure-time activities for young people in Germany.

returned_title: Opinions and Values of Egyptian Students in West Germany

justification: This dataset repository hosted on GESIS contains the code and syntax files used to replicate the analyses in the study on socio-economic status, comparisons of subjective affectedness, and life satisfaction during the COVID-19 pandemic in Germany.
